rules.statement: A party to a partition action who is entitled to compensation for improvements is entitled to remain in possession of such improvements until compensated, and can claim damages if wrongfully dispossessed before final decree.
rules.supporting_quote: I think the plaintiff is entitled to damages until he is restored to possession, or until final decree in entered, whichever event takes place earlier ; for once final decree is entered some trees would at least fall on his lot and he would not be able to claim damages for the dispossession of those trees.
